bed_tempo.comment: instrumental/regular beds play near-native; sample tempo_ratio ~ N(1, sigma). Do NOT apply the old ±6% master_tempo_jitter. sigma is robust (from p10-p90 band); a few bed outliers make the raw stdev misleadingly large.

overlay_warp.comment: acappella/regular overlays: DERIVE, never sample. tempo_ratio = mix_BPM / payload_native_BPM. mix_BPM = current bed_BPM * bed_tempo_ratio. This formula already exists at scenario_v2.py:198 (tempo_ratio(host,payload)) but is dead (master_bpm=None).
overlay_warp.octave_fold_comment: with prob ~0.10, DJ picks half/double time to keep the vocal in a natural register — multiply/divide the derived ratio by 2. (Also masks Essentia octave errors; treat as approximate.)

cut_up.comment: axis 2 — instrumental beds get chopped & jump-arranged (warp-marker-heavy at tempo_ratio~1). Generator's instr_jump_prob is directionally right; tune to these.

pitch_shift_semi.comment: small integer semitone; mixing-in-key keeps it tight

bed_bpm_sample.comment: draw a per-window master/bed BPM from these percentiles (empirical bed native BPMs across BB11+BB12)
